module: Console utility script that reopens and re-saves all vehicle configurations (*.pc) in the vehicles/ folder. For each vehicle, it spawns the object in slot 0, loads each config with partmgmt.loadLocal then saves it with partmgmt.saveLocal. ResaveConfigs() is launched automatically at the end of the file.
notes: The "common", "box" and "bathtub" vehicles are skipped (known to fail on spawn according to the code comment).
The loadLocal/saveLocal commands are sent by be:queueLuaCommand (vehicle VM); BeamEngine:update(2, 2) is called after each config to execute them.
The script launches on import: it deletes all objects (BeamEngine:deleteAllObjects) for each vehicle processed.

ResaveConfigs.desc: Walks all folders in vehicles/, spawns each vehicle, and reloads then saves each of its .pc configs. Prints progress with io.write and the total number of configs re-saved.
